thesis: Restaurant Brands International (NYSE and TSX: QSR), franchisor of Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes, Firehouse. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-29) read. Q3 revenue 2,525M (+3.1%), 9M 7,309M (+4.9%); system-wide sales +6.2% Q3, comparable sales +3.8%; income from operations 9M 2,018M vs 1,581M. Reported 9M NI 1,814M includes an income tax benefit of 168M (effective rate -10.2%) from intra-group reorganization. 9M OCF 1,308M, capex 181M; paid 875M dividends and distributions and bought back 444M; debt 13.5B vs cash 0.97B; 2026-11-17 priced senior secured notes to repay term loan B. Close 72.91 (2026-11-20) x 451.3M shares including exchangeable units = 32.9B = 16.7x reported TTM NI 1,969M (about 23x normalized for tax, own estimate), TTM FCF about 1.58B (4.8%).
counterthesis: Reported earnings are flattered by a one-off deferred tax benefit; net debt about 12.5B (about 2.7x revenue-scale leverage, secured debt); dividends plus buybacks consume nearly all FCF; the stock has drifted from 75.4 to 72.9 over a week with no catalyst found; franchisee health and Burger King US trends not examined.
invalidation: Downgrade if comparable sales turn negative, normalized FCF per share falls, leverage rises, or the secured notes refinancing raises interest cost materially; upgrade case needs normalized earnings confirmed at a lower multiple.
